metadata.title: Simon's algorithm (secret 11)
metadata.notes: The oracle f(x) = x0 xor x1 gives the same answer for x and x xor 11. Every outcome y is orthogonal to the secret (y·s = 0), so 00 and 11 appear and 01, 10 never do; a few runs pin down s, where a classical search needs exponentially many queries in general.
